_help: The asset and access checklist the client gets at onboarding (spec 5.6). "all" goes to every client; the track lists are added on top. category: brand, access, logistics or legal. required: false means the item never blocks the project. Wording here is what the client reads.

all.label: Logo files (vector if you have them)
Brand colours and fonts, or your brand guidelines
Three accounts or videos you love, and what you like about each
Name and number of the one person who approves the work
Location address, access times, parking and power notes
Any no-go rules: people who cannot be filmed, areas off limits, competitor products (or "none")

retainer.label: Instagram and TikTok access for Studiio: partner or collaborator access through Meta Business Suite, never a shared password
Meta ad account access (only if ads are part of the work)
Your products, services and price list
Calendar of launches, offers and events for the next two months

production.label: Approved script or concept, or confirmation that Studiio writes it
Product samples needed on set, with the date they arrive
Names of the talent or staff on camera, and when they are available

photography.label: Shot list, or the list of products, rooms or people
Where the photos will be used (this sets the format and crop)
